source.author: verg
source.text: Hoc pater Anchises auro libabat ad aras; hoc Priami gestamen erat, cum iura vocatis more daret populis, sceptrumque sacerque tiaras Iliadumque labor vestes.
source.text_original: Hoc pater Anchises auro libabat ad aras; / hoc Priami gestamen erat, cum iura vocatis / more daret populis, sceptrumque sacerque tiaras / Iliadumque labor vestes.'
source.text_english: This, father Anchises was offering in gold at the altars; this was Priam’s emblem when, as king, he gave laws to the summoned peoples, and the scepter and sacred tiara, and the labor of the men of Troy in their robes.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_original: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum / poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_english: craters and tables and altars of the gods fly about, and cups, a notable workmanship of the ancients.
